problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet of 8 specialized transport vehicles to deliver 8 distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 8.3 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 7.616 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 9.749 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 18.218 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 8.472 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 14.737 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 16.01 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 15.129 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each vehicle type is provided:
*For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 requires 0.54 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.83 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.69 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.17 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.944 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.592 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.194 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.318 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 requires 0.876 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.918 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.835 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.371 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.735 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.488 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.852 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.029 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 requires 0.961 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.813 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.165 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.57 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.52 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.323 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.993 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.789 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.121 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.82 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.753 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.524 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.891 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.427 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.478 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.174 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 requires 0.474 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.263 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.31 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.129 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.236 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.949 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.044 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.905 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 requires 0.358 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.164 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.419 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.412 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.549 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.502 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.563 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.633 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.277 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.932 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.798 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.186 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.146 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.593 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.364 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.864 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Vehicle 1 requires 0.379 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.434 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.552 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.238 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.35 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.977 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.911 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.354 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 1 must not exceed 83.921
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 2 must not exceed 120.549
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 3 must not exceed 110.873
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 4 must not exceed 114.572
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 5 must not exceed 127.275
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 6 must not exceed 76.651
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 7 must not exceed 115.892
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 8 must not exceed 100.201

Under the stipulation that for each vehicle type—Vehicle 1 through Vehicle 8—the total handling duration must remain within its available operational capacity, the firm must determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
